article.title: Unbounce公布AI混合編輯器，可由提示詞、範本或空白頁起稿
article.title_en: Unbounce announces a hybrid AI builder with prompts, templates or blank pages
article.summary: 新工具把落地頁生成、手動編輯及測試放在同一流程，新自助帳戶會使用該編輯器。
article.summary_en: The builder combines generation, manual editing and testing. New self-serve accounts use it.
highlights: 團隊可修改生成初稿，也可直接使用範本或拖放元件。
官方說明指既有帳戶的頁面與編輯器暫時維持原狀。
highlights_en: Teams can edit AI drafts or start from templates or drag-and-drop components.
Official documentation says existing accounts retain their pages and builder for now.
article.why: 團隊可按任務選擇起稿方式，並保留對優惠文案、表單及量度設定的控制。
article.why_en: Teams can choose how to start while retaining control over offers, forms and measurement.
article.next_step: 先用一個有清楚轉化目標的活動，比對版面、表單及事件是否按預期運作。
article.next_step_en: Test one campaign with a defined conversion goal and verify layout, form and event behaviour.
article.detail: 公告所說的混合方式，是讓行銷人員在生成與手動編輯之間選擇。官方文件另說明新自助帳戶與現有帳戶的安排，所以準備測試前宜先查自己的編輯器版本。若同一活動要比較兩個落地頁，應固定主要受眾與優惠，再單獨比較一項改動，並先確認表單和轉化事件有記錄。測試前宜先定義合格名單的條件。
article.detail_en: Hybrid means marketers can choose between generation and manual editing. The docs distinguish new self-serve from existing accounts, so confirm builder access first. For a page test, keep audience and offer fixed, isolate one change and verify form submissions and conversion events. Define what counts as a qualified lead before testing.
